"""P18: hold no-index / 36 m / 60 d every round, the three accepted round-1 claims, volume framing."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import hold_close_policy

CASE = "case:P18"
R1 = ("Dear Mr Seidl,

thank you for your letter of 22 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next "
      "36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.

"
      "Alloy surcharge 1.4404 changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
"
      "Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
"
      "Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

"
      "We commit 23,700 kg a year for 36 months at EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days.

"
      "Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
LATER = ("Dear Mr Seidl,

thank you. We commit 23,700 kg a year, binding for 36 months. We prefer a fixed price over a "
         "surcharge clause and can move to EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days, 36 months.

"
         "Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
CLOSE = ("Dear Sir,

we are very close. If you can do EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed price without a clause, 60 days, 36 months, we sign today and place the first call-off this week.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
move = hold_close_policy(CASE, 4.85, {"index_clause": None, "payment_days": 60, "contract_months": 36}, R1, LATER, CLOSE, 0.1 if CASE == 'case:P18' else 0.05)

case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: case:P18 - our proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

thank you for your letter of 22 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next 36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.

Alloy surcharge 1.4404 changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We commit 23,700 kg a year for 36 months at EUR 4.85 per kg, fixed, 60 days.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: case:P18 - our proposal
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We have factored the verified decreases in the alloy surcharge and producer prices into our revised calculation.

While we accept your 36-month term and 60-day payment, the volatility of raw materials requires us to apply the AS-14404 surcharge clause rather than a fixed price. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. With this clause in place, we can offer a base price of EUR 5.50 per kg, and we kindly ask you to share the details of your updated volume forecast. Which volume can you commit to?

Our primary proposal is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit. As another option, we present a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: case:P18 - our proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

thank you. We commit 23,700 kg a year, binding for 36 months. We prefer a fixed price over a surcharge clause and can move to EUR 5.01 per kg, fixed, 60 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: case:P18 - our proposal
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Thank you for confirming the volume of 23,700 kg per year; please provide the corresponding binding release schedule as proof. As previously stated, the volatility of raw materials makes a fixed price impossible for a 36-month term, so we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. 

With this clause, we are pleased to offer a reduced base price of EUR 5.30 per kg. For our full Angebot, we state a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: case:P18 - we can sign today
message.body:
Dear Sir,

we are very close. If you can do EUR 5.20 per kg, fixed price without a clause, 60 days, 36 months, we sign today and place the first call-off this week.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: case:P18 - we can sign today
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to present our updated terms to support your requirements with a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. However, a fixed price over 36 months remains impossible due to raw material volatility, making the AS-14404 index clause mandatory. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to your confirmation and receiving your first call-off this week.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
